answer: Dynamic opportunity-cost bonds lock staking collateral into a time-varying yield curve, making Sybil creation forego the foregone interest on honest capital. A subgame-perfect punishment matrix imposes slashing penalties scaled by attack magnitude and a zero-knowledge verifiable delay, ensuring negative expected attack utility for any deviation. The resulting equilibrium behaves like a glacier, its deterrent sharp as yarrow, while the delay propagates through a vine of commitments to secure a strict Nash equilibrium.
